repairs.before: Note: According to the Yuan History, the Season Granting Calendar was completed in the seventeenth year of Zhizheng.
repairs.after: Note: According to the Yuan History, the Season Granting Calendar was completed in the seventeenth year of Zhiyuan.
repairs.reason: Chapter source 按《元史》，至正十七年《授時曆》成 preserves a scribal 至正 surface, but the calendar-reform context with Wang Xun and Guo Shoujing and Yuan shi 52 witness require Yuan Shizu 至元十七年 (AD 1280); English must not render the anachronistic Zhizheng reign.
